rows.grounds: instrumental plural of compound divya-gandha describing substances applied
past participle describing the state of the subject
compound divya-puṣpa-upaśobhita describing ornamentation of the subject

items.question: With what divine adornments is the righteous being distinguished in heavenly enjoyment?
premises: The subject is anointed with divine fragrances.
The subject is adorned with divine flowers.
These attributes characterize the being's state in heaven.
items.inference: The righteous being experiences heavenly enjoyment marked by divine fragrance and floral adornment.
uncertainties: The subject is carried over from the previous verse and not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: Anointed with divine fragrances and adorned with divine flowers.
